title: ISO 9906:2012 — Rotodynamic pumps — Hydraulic performance acceptance tests — Grades 1, 2 and 3
version: ISO 9906:2012, Edition 2; official lifecycle page shows review stage 90.60
locator: Abstract and scope: hydraulic performance acceptance tests for rotodynamic pumps (centrifugal, mixed flow and axial); test fluids are required to behave as clean, cold water.
notes: The ISO lifecycle page displays review-stage information. Do not assume this standard is directly applicable to contaminated coolant, emulsions or slurry without checking pump type, fluid behaviour, test arrangement and the contract. It is a pump acceptance test method, not a machine-tool coolant system specification.
